Standalone English word 'diffusion' left in Latin script mid-sentence; it is not a protected proper noun here (unlike 'Stable Diffusion') and should be rendered in Arabic or glossed.

findings.span: باستخدام Gemini تحويل صورة إلى صورة
findings.suggestion: باستخدام جيميني لتحويل صورة إلى صورة
findings.reason: The glossary requires 'Gemini' to be rendered as 'جيميني'; here it is left in Latin script (standalone product mention, not the node name GeminiImage2Node).
Glossary requires 'this workflow' → 'سير العمل هذا'; the pre-posed demonstrative is also less natural/ambiguous in Arabic.
Inconsistent rendering of 'casting': the title uses 'اختيار المواهب' while the body uses the transliteration 'كاستينغ' (also 'لقطة الكاستينغ' in howToUse).
'خطوة الثابت' is ungrammatical/elliptical Arabic; the English refers to two steps (still and video).
Latin word 'dolly' inserted mid-sentence as a verb complement reads ungrammatically in Arabic; inconsistent with 'dolly-in' usage elsewhere.
'السوشيال' is a colloquial English transliteration; the standard rendering for social media content is 'وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي', which is also the mandated term.
'الستايل' is a colloquial borrowing inconsistent with the formal register used elsewhere in the page.
'preset' is rendered as 'الإعدادات الجاهزة' in the extendedDescription and howToUse but as 'مُعد مسبقًا' here, creating inconsistent terminology across the page.
Duplicated comparative word 'مثل ... مثل' reads awkwardly; a native writer would not repeat it.
